cases.regionalContext: Lagos danfo owner types fast pidgin, uses 'k' for thousands and 'abeg' as softener; NGN amounts.
lessons: '20k' must parse to ₦20,000, not 20 or 20,000 litres — na naira amount.

turns.text: abeg how my fuel spend dey look this week?
This week you don spend ₦34,500 on petrol across 3 logs — highest na Tuesday at ₦15,000.
ok. nw log 20k petrol for the danfo
Got it — ₦20,000 petrol for the danfo. Which date should I put am, today?
yes today, na morning fill
Noted, morning fill today. Send CONFIRM make I lock am.
wait who dey drive? na Musa bus
Okay, so na Musa's bus. Still ₦20,000 petrol, today morning. Reply CONFIRM to save.

cases.reply: Logged ✓ ₦20,000 petrol — Musa's bus, today morning fill.
cases.note: Quick-log petrol for danfo bus in k-shorthand — Lagos danfo owner types fast pidgin, uses 'k' for thousands and 'abeg' as softener; NGN amounts.

cases.regionalContext: Owner juggles a generator service and a keke fuel log in one chat; 'no wahala' and 'abeg' typical.
lessons: When owner switches mid-flow, answer the side question then return — but only confirm the entry they actually approve.

turns.text: abeg i wan log generator service for the shop, 45k
Okay — ₦45,000 generator service for the shop. Which date, and na which generator?
wait first, how much fuel my keke don chop this month?
Your keke fuel this month na ₦58,200 across 6 logs. Back to the generator — ₦45,000 service, which date?
today. na the 3.5kva gen
Noted — 3.5kVA generator, ₦45,000 service, today. Reply CONFIRM make I save am.
CONFIRM
and abeg log 8k petrol for the keke too, today

cases.note: Generator service interrupted by keke fuel question — Owner juggles a generator service and a keke fuel log in one chat; 'no wahala' and 'abeg' typical.

cases.regionalContext: Owner has two Toyota Corolla (2015 & 2018) — plates fictional; asks fuel average then logs for 'my car'.
lessons: When two same-model vehicles dey, resolve 'my car' from the last vehicle discussed, no repeat the same question.

turns.text: wetin be my fuel average this month?
You get two Corolla on file — KDA 777A (2015) and LAG-123-XY (2018). Which one you mean?
the 2018 one
LAG-123-XY dey do about 9.2 km/l this month, based on your logs.
ok log 15k petrol for my car
Which car — LAG-123-XY (2018) or KDA 777A (2015)?
my car na the one we just talk about now
No wahala — that one na LAG-123-XY (2018). ₦15,000 petrol, today?

cases.note: Two same-model cars, ambiguous 'my car' fuel log — Owner has two Toyota Corolla (2015 & 2018) — plates fictional; asks fuel average then logs for 'my car'.
